hypotheses.A: Synthetic-oriented 1-cosine response to normalized-tensor Gaussian noise provides useful evidence beyond a static DINOv2 head at separately calibrated specificity.
hypotheses.B: PE-Core-B16-224 pooled projected visual features with a legitimate small logistic head improve the same bounded specificity/rescue comparison.

modelChoices.A: dinov2_vitl14, official CLS 1024-D, RIGID notebook measurement CPU port; not reproduction of its dataset benchmark
modelChoices.B: PE-Core-B16-224 official vision attention pool plus projection, 1024-D, no text inference; LYTHAUS_ADAPTATION, not Simplicity Prevails headline reproduction

RIGID.seedDerivation: SHA256 canonical [public seed, tensor hash, draw] first 8 bytes modulo 2^63-1; label and traversal blind
RIGID.upstreamLabelCorrection: Notebook treats real as positive. N uses synthetic=1 for AUROC, AP, recall and FPR.

views.reference: Full uploaded source/descendant, EXIF-transposed RGB, no ICC conversion; each documented model preprocessing follows. A/B both squash full view to224 with bilinear but normalize differently. SAFE remains native center256, ToTensor, no normalization.
views.matched: First by stable sample hash in PHOTO_CSAFE, PHOTO_UNSPLASH, Seedream-4 and SD-3.5-Large; original and JPEG75; common full-view256 bilinear squash, then each native preprocessing. External view adaptation is explicit. Fixed reference-trained heads and thresholds unchanged.

externalTransforms.calibration8Parents: all six conditions, no synthetic calibration
externalTransforms.jpeg: Pillow/libjpeg, subsampling2, baseline, optimizeFalse; retain exact DQT and sampling
externalTransforms.resize: PIL LANCZOS at rounded75percent full dimensions
externalTransforms.png: lossless current-pixel and metadata-removal invariance only, no erasure of prior history
externalTransforms.secondCodec: Engineering pixel/backend equivalence check using existing Sharp; identical decoded rows are not an independent encoder experiment

fitting.B1: PE original/JPEG95/JPEG75 features, both classes, equal aggregate parent weight
fitting.trainingRights: DDB record-level TRAINING_ALLOWED_WITH_CONSTRAINTS and CC0; consumed CSAFE CC_BY4.0, attribution retained; no T2I/Unsplash/Cloudflare fitting
fitting.featureNormalization: unit L2 then StandardScaler fitted only on FIT rows; B1 three descendants per parent uniformly weighted
fitting.classifier: sklearn LogisticRegression L2 lbfgs intercept, max_iter2000, class_weight null, seed2026091907
fitting.devSelection: Max synthetic TP strictly above maximum DEV-negative score; then DEV average precision; then smaller C. DEV devices and prompt IDs separate from FIT. Only SD1 available for both FIT/DEV; generator transfer assessed on excluded challenge families.
fitting.permutation: Fixed parent-level FIT and DEV label permutations independently, same complete selection and calibration procedure; evaluation labels unchanged
fitting.nuisanceBaseline: same head recipe, source/current dimensions, aspect, format, DQT mean, contrast, gradient sharpness, clipped fraction, channel mean; no dataset, filename, generator or SAFE scores
fitting.combinedResponseHead: DEFERRED_OPTIONAL; no authorized budget for response-feature fitting beyond A0

calibration.population: Three CSAFE device groups; no processed-photo or actual-human-digital calibration; resolution1/8=12.5percent
calibration.rule: Strict score > maximum negative calibration score; ties negative. With N=8, floor(0.01*N)=0 allowed calibration exceedances. Separate original threshold and maximum-across-six-conditions threshold for each candidate, frozen before evaluation.

advancement.interpretation: Missing actual human digital population blocks PROMISING_BOUNDED_SIGNAL; a photo-limited lead may merit an explicitly constrained further test. Positive training fit never qualifies a detector. Single-family training, small calibration, historical exposure and unknown pretraining membership remain limitations.
